biotools.summary: BEERS2 is a software tool for RNA-Seq simulation that combines a flexible design with detailed modeling of the library preparation and sequencing pipeline. It allows for the generation of realistic RNA-Seq reads, facilitating the assessment and benchmarking of bioinformatics tools.
